title: Motor starter as a Moore state machine
algorithm: Moore finite state machine with structural checks
plant_model: Motor feedback modelled as two fixed delays (1.5 s run, 3.0 s stop)

dataset.name: none
dataset.description: Scripted scenarios and seeded random events.

status.software: Executed from a clean kernel; local unit tests passed at build time; GitHub Actions has not been run on this repository

limitations: Idealised delay model for motor feedback; no bounce, debounce or scan jitter.
Structural checks cover the transition table only, not electrical interlocks.
Enumeration and testing, not formal model checking.

checks.name: intended machine: no unreachable and no deadlock states
checker finds the planted unreachable state
checker finds the planted deadlock state
contactor is open in IDLE, STOPPING, FAULT, ESTOP
estop leads to ESTOP from every other state in one step
ESTOP exits only to FAULT (no automatic restart)
contactor-closed states entered only by start from IDLE and run_fb from STARTING
FSM equals the if/elif reference on 20 000 random events
